text:
jose_pm: Thanks for the All-hands — quick clarifying Qs for leadership: can we get concrete windows and acceptance criteria for (1) API batching/latency work, (2) Console rollout canary -> GA, (3) Optimize recommendations (quant profiles / auto-suggest)? Need to update customer-facing comms and internal playbooks. Dates + top blockers would be great.

sarah_lead: Short answer first: batching primitives canary by end of Q2, GA in early Q3; Console: internal canary next week, customer beta in ~4 weeks, GA after beta feedback; Optimize: passive suggestions in Q3, active auto-apply tentatively Q4 pending compliance.

matt_engineering: For batching specifically: runtime kernels are merged in my branch, perf harness still running. Target canary: 2025-07-10. Main blocker: memory regression on long-seq workloads on older GPUs — investigating.

anna_prod: Console rollout plan: internal 10% canary next Tue, expand to internal beta subset, then invited customers (beta cohort) ~4w. Acceptance criteria: per-route toggle, rollout metrics dashboard, one-click rollback.

jose_pm: @anna_prod for "beta cohort" — do we have the customer list or criteria to pick them? also can we get acceptance criteria doc by EoW?

anna_prod: We have a shortlist (strategic SMBs + two enterprise partners). I'll share the list and draft acceptance criteria by EOD today in the roadmap doc.

matt_engineering: I'll add the perf checklist to the infra runbook. Quick draft:
```
- p50 latency change <= 5% on common payloads
- no new 5xx error classes in canary
- kv-cache mem increase < 10%
- smoke tests for streaming and function calls
```

sarah_lead: Optimize recommendations scope note: Phase 1 = passive suggestions surfaced in Console + API (read-only). Phase 2 = customer opt-in auto-suggest apply flow (requires audit logs + undo). Private deployments might need extra approvals (KMS/HSM audit).

kevin_support: +1 on the support blurb. Support needs a succinct beta FAQ and a short troubleshooting checklist for regressions. Can we get that before beta starts?

anna_prod: I'll write the support blurb and post to #support today. Will include "how to opt-out" and rollback steps.

slides-bot: Recording & slides: https://redwood.zoom/recording/abcd1234 — see slide 14 (timeline) and slide 18 (risk flags).

ops-bot: Canary ticket created: INFR-4721. Canary window scheduled: 2025-07-10T16:00Z -> 2025-07-17T16:00Z. Will post alerts in #eng-oncall during the window.

jose_pm: Perfect — can leads drop final dates into the shared roadmap doc (link in #product)? I'll hold customer comms until those are in.

matt_engineering: Will add dates + risk bullets to the roadmap by EOD tomorrow. I'll annotate which features are optional vs blocking for GA.

sarah_lead: We'll follow up with a short sync if any of the blockers persist after perf runs. Thanks for flagging, @jose_pm.

jose_pm: Thanks all. If anything slips, please update the roadmap and drop a short note here so I can adjust external comms. :thumbsup:
